apiTokens.permissionsHint: Administration and node permissions are separate. Write permission includes reading its resource. Database and backup access requires both groups. Full administration selects both write permissions.

apiTokens.usageHint: Set API_TOKEN to your secret and PANEL_URL to this panel's origin. Send a bearer header; browser cookies and request signatures are not required. Mutations keep their existing idempotency requirements.
